subject: RStan:  OK to delete Google Code pages?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: RStan:  OK to delete Google Code pages?
parts:
Can I now delete the Google Code page for Stan?

The new web pages only point at the GitHub readme
for RStan.

It looks like Jiqiang figured out how to install
from GitHub, at least according to this:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases

which indicates all a user need do is

> library(devtools)
> install_url('https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/releases/download/v1.3.0/rstan_1.3.0.tar.gz')

- Bob
